reviews_captured_by_me.text: KGF upgraded our kitchen and bathroom. As a first time homeowner, KGF helped us with ideas and a proper direction to achieve our upgrades with the look we wanted. KGF answered all our questions and overproduced with craftsmanship. I believe the owner's name is Kyle, who was exceptionally polite and understanding with any concerns we had. We went from a outdated 1970s look to now a more cleaner, finished, modern look. We absolutely love our new kitchen and bathroom. I absolutely would recommend KGF to any homeowners. We were troubled on deciding on going with a company that's always on TV or not. We decided we wanted somebody more local. We're so glad we found KGF. They are more of a family, oriented, professional company. Thank you KGF. Will be seeing you soon for our basement upgrades. ⭐ x'5

KGF Improvement did an excellent job from start to finish. They were professional, reliable, and paid great attention to detail. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for home improvement services. Great experience!

I had an excellent experience with KGF Home Improvement! Their trim work was outstanding, with incredible attention to detail and a flawless finish. They also did an amazing job on my cabinets, and the quality of the craftsmanship exceeded my expectations.

What really set them apart was their customer service. They were professional, responsive, and easy to work with from start to finish. They took the time to answer all my questions and made sure everything was done exactly the way I wanted.

If you’re looking for high-quality trim work, cabinet installation or refinishing, and a company that truly cares about its customers, I highly recommend KGF Home Improvement. I couldn’t be happier with the results!
